confirmed_primary_defect.description: Hierarchy attachment uses post-recovery measurement ownership rather than immutable direct-seed ownership. Expanded owners can intersect multiple fine-scale features and are rejected before their common-parent convergence is considered.
confirmed_primary_defect.scientific_effect: The intended catalogue-source grouping remains dormant, so source-level remeasurement and source-union topology are applied mostly to singleton components.
confirmed_primary_defect.semantic_contract_violation: The hierarchy docstring promises direct component owners, but the composed caller supplies support-expanded measurement owners.

controlled_reproduction.fixture: Two direct owners attach to fine-scale features with one unique coarse parent; support recovery expands the first owner across two of those fine features.

evaluator_and_adapter.evidence: The writer persists source membership in source identifiers and component counts; the prospective evaluator verifies that digest against native labels and reconstructs exact source-union support. A grouped membership would therefore be visible to binding topology metrics.

exact_overlap_scale_shift.description: A physical source feature may move between wavelet scales and fail exact adjacent-scale overlap. No governed or analytic evidence yet establishes that this caused the terminal failure.

mask_support.evidence: Connected-support admission changed mask precision by only 1.794e-7, mask recall by -6.510e-7, and mask IoU by 3.414e-7, with no endpoint transition.
mask_support.remaining_question: The remaining precision deficit concerns connected retained support and must be reproduced prospectively; it does not authorize a threshold or radius change.

terminal_evidence_limit.consequence: The primary cause is high-confidence rather than campaign-level conclusive; the next candidate must emit compact activation telemetry before another replay can be considered.
terminal_evidence_limit.description: The sealed products and ledger contain no aggregate hierarchy activation record, and the raw candidate shards were removed after verified terminal compilation. Campaign-level ambiguous, unattached, converged, and membership-size counts cannot be recovered retrospectively.

ultimate_root_overmerge.description: Grouping every lineage that reaches the same terminal coarse root can merge independent nearby sources. The passing zero-merge terminal evidence does not exercise an activated hierarchy, so coarse-bridge and crowded-field negative controls remain mandatory.

recommended_repair.attachment_rule: Attach immutable direct-seed support to the complete set of finest intersected features; accept grouping only when their lineages provide one unique nearest common convergence. Zero or multiple convergence candidates remain flagged singletons.

identity_separation.direct_component_labels: immutable hierarchy attachment and component identity
identity_separation.measurement_component_labels: connected recovered support ownership for masks and source measurement

recommended_repair.source_measurement_and_evaluator: Retain unchanged unless a focused fixture independently demonstrates a defect after membership activates.
